summary: Open Text Corporation filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, furnishing Item 2.02 quarterly results for the period ended September 30, 2026, and disclosing under Item 8.01 a declared quarterly cash dividend of $0.28 per common share, payable December 18, 2026, to holders of record December 4, 2026. The board reaffirmed its dividend policy while flagging credit-agreement constraints and quarterly board discretion. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is present; this is a routine earnings-and-dividend current report with no special-situations angle to trade.
